name: National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Establishment of Seed Garden
benefit: - **For Establishment of New Seed Orchards:** ₹80,00,000/- per seed garden. Minimum area requirement is 15 hectares. - **Nursery Development Assistance:** ₹40,00,000/- per nursery for infrastructure and operational support.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
